description: Typical market rent for US metro areas or cities from the Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI, Zillow Research's official public data, all home types, smoothed, USD per month): latest monthly value, change vs 12 months earlier and monthly history for every region whose name matches (up to 10, largest first), with state, metro and county. Index data, not individual listings (zillow.com listing pages block automated access). Updated monthly. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

level.description: metro (default; includes the United States row) or city

months.description: How many recent monthly values per region, 1-120 (default 12)

region.description: Region name or part of it, e.g. 'Austin', 'New York, NY', 'United States' (required)

state.description: Optional 2-letter state code to narrow matches, e.g. TX

name: realestate_zillow_rentals
title: Realestate Zillow Rentals
